candidates.name: Blocky Character (red)
candidates.notes: Kenney 'Blocky Characters' pack, character-b. 72 tris, single 1024px colormap texture (embedded by scout; original pack ships external Textures/*.png). Coral-red shirt matches house palette. 27 baked animations incl. idle, attack-melee-right/left, die, walk, emote-yes/no — articulated as plain node hierarchy (root/leg/arm/torso/head), no skin. Raw height 9u, lowest vert y=-1 so scale 0.144 + yOffset +0.144 puts feet at 0, height ~1.3. Likely faces -Z or +Z; flip in loader if backwards.

candidates.name: Blocky Character (yellow)
candidates.notes: Same rig/mesh as red variant, character-d texture: sun-yellow shirt. Identical stats: 72 tris, 1 embedded colormap, 27 node animations incl. melee attacks + die. Recolorable by swapping the embedded texture. Feet land at y=0 with this scale/offset.

candidates.name: Blocky Character (purple)
candidates.notes: Same rig/mesh, character-e texture: berry-purple shirt, light skin. Identical stats: 72 tris, 1 embedded colormap, 27 node animations incl. melee attacks + die. Good third lineup variant.

candidates.name: Gnome Boxer
candidates.notes: By portomat — 'a gnome with big gloves'. Thematically perfect: chibi gnome already wearing boxing gloves. 226 tris, 5 flat-color materials (no texture — recolor via material.color). No rig/anims. Raw bbox y -1..5.935 (origin ~1u above lowest vertex — probably a glove hanging low); scale 0.187 + yOffset +0.187 gives ~1.3 tall. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC-BY): credit 'portomat via poly.pizza'.

candidates.name: Male Fighter
candidates.notes: By mastjie. Low-poly humanoid fighter, 4232 tris, 1 texture (f_txr_03.png embedded). 7 animation clips but only ~4 are real ('...Action'..'Action.003' — unnamed Blender actions, likely idle/punches; CameraAction/SpotAction/CubeAction are export junk to ignore). No skin — node/morph anims. Authored tiny: raw height 0.043u, feet already at y=0; scale 30 -> ~1.29 tall. Facing/poses unknown — verify in lineup.

candidates.name: Eye Fighter
candidates.notes: By Polygonal Mind (100Avatars series). Oddball cyclops-blob fighter — very Punch-Out!!-style weird opponent. 3736 tris, 1 texture. Flat-card style: bbox x only 0.006 thick, y 0..0.038, z 0..0.042 — likely authored facing +/-X or Z-up; scale ~32 by Y-extent and it may need a Y-rotation (or X-rotation if Z is up). Verify orientation in lineup; cheap fallback is a billboard. AUTO-FIT applied; flat-card model — may need pitch fix in-scene.

candidates.name: Boxing Ring (prop)
candidates.notes: PROP — scene dressing, not a lineup character. By Zaw Imagineering. 824 tris, 30 meshes, 4 flat-color materials. Normalized to a 2x2x2 cube centered at origin: scale 2.6 gives a 5.2u footprint (matches RingSim radius 2.6 diameter) with yOffset +2.6 putting the base at 0; canvas top lands ~+5.2u — likely wants a non-uniform squash (e.g. scale.y ~0.6) so fighters aren't on a tower. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC-BY): credit 'Zaw Imagineering via poly.pizza'.

candidates.name: Boxing Gloves pair (prop)
candidates.notes: PROP. By Zsky. Two named meshes RBoxingGloves1 + LBoxingGloves1 — could decorate the ring or be split for NPC gloves. 800 tris, 4 flat materials (upper/lower per glove) — recolor via material.color for house coral. Authored microscopic (0.002u): scale 250 -> ~0.5u glove pair; yOffset +0.25 grounds it. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC-BY): credit 'Zsky via poly.pizza'.

candidates.name: Punching Bag freestanding (prop)
candidates.notes: PROP. By Zsky. Freestanding bag on base+bar (3 named parts), 300 tris, 3 flat materials. Long axis is +Z (authored Z-up): rotate -90deg X to stand upright, or treat scale as needs-review. scale 45 -> ~0.8u along Z. Centered origin. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC-BY): credit 'Zsky via poly.pizza'.
